dota_tooltip_ability_medusa_gorgon_grasp: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
dota_tooltip_ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
dota_tooltip_Ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
dota_tooltip_ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.
dota_tooltip_ability_phantom_assassin_im:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks. Evasion improves with Phantom Assassin's levels. 

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
dota_tooltip_ability_slark_saltwater_shi: Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.  This effect stacks.
Subsequent use of Saltwater Shiv refreshes the duration of all Shiv stacks.
